name: sys_notify
description: Send system status notification via Telegram

name: get_my_location
description: Query location coordinates, reverse address lookup, weather, and altitude.

provider.description: Location provider: gps, network, cell (default: gps)

fallbacks.description: Comma-separated fallback providers in order of execution (default: network)

speed_unit.description: Speed representation unit: ms, kmh, mph (default: ms)

alt_unit.description: Altitude representation unit: meters, feet (default: meters)

user_agent.description: HTTP User-Agent header for API requests

timeout.description: Subprocess and connection timeouts in seconds (default: 15)

output.description: Write output report directly to this file

lat.description: Coordinate latitude override (mocks GPS location query)

lon.description: Coordinate longitude override (mocks GPS location query)

loop_delay.description: Seconds to wait between queries in continuous monitoring mode

json.description: Output result formatted as a raw JSON payload

open.description: Automatically open the Google Maps link in browser

share.description: Share output report text via termux-share command

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging outputs to stderr

dry_run.description: Simulate geocoding/weather calls with dummy coordinates
